servinfo.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Encoder Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front and Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Encoder Inspection

attention3.ptxt: Rear wheel speed sensor encoder is included in rear wheel hub assembly. If rear wheel speed sensor encoder needs to be replaced, replace rear wheel hub assembly.

servinfo.ptxt: For removal and installation of rear wheel speed sensor encoder (included in rear wheel hub assembly), refer to Rear Wheel Hub Assembly Removal and Installation:Rear .
